name: Hippocampal place cells
description: CA1/CA3 pyramidal neurons firing selectively when animal occupies specific spatial location; cognitive map substrate. Substrate-relevant: place fields as substrate atoms binding location-context.

name: Entorhinal grid cells
description: Medial entorhinal cortex cells firing at hexagonal-lattice spatial positions; periodic spatial code with multiple scales. Substrate-relevant: multi-scale spatial atom basis + periodic encoding.

name: Theta-gamma phase coupling
description: Cross-frequency coupling: gamma cycles nested within theta cycle; multiple items per theta cycle via gamma phase coding. Substrate-relevant: temporal binding mechanism for slot-filler pairs.

name: Cognitive map (Tolman)
description: Internal representation of environmental relations enabling latent learning + flexible navigation. Substrate-relevant: substrate-as-cognitive-map for concept relations + capability paths.

name: Working memory (Baddeley)
description: Multi-component model: phonological loop + visuospatial sketchpad + central executive + episodic buffer. Substrate-relevant: substrate as long-term + working substrate as scratchpad binding.

name: Predictive coding (Rao-Ballard)
description: Hierarchical generative model: higher layers predict lower layer activity; prediction errors propagate up. Substrate-relevant: substrate as prediction engine + error-driven atom updates.

name: Dopaminergic reward prediction error
description: Midbrain VTA/SNc dopamine neurons fire as TD-error signal; basis for reinforcement learning in brain. Substrate-relevant: RPE-driven substrate atom credit assignment.

name: Cerebellar internal forward model
description: Cerebellum predicts sensory consequences of motor commands; forward model for motor control + cognition. Substrate-relevant: substrate as internal forward model for capability prediction.

name: Default mode network
description: Brain network active during rest + internally-directed cognition (memory + planning + self-reference). Substrate-relevant: substrate-as-self-knowing engine analogue.

name: Anderson localization
description: Wave localization in disordered media; eigenstates exponentially localized in 1D/2D + transition in 3D. Substrate-relevant: localized atom retrieval under disorder + cleanup attractors.

name: BCS superconductivity
description: Cooper pair condensation + phonon-mediated attraction + macroscopic coherent state. Substrate-relevant: collective coherent state analogue for substrate-bundle macroscopic readout.

name: Lorenz chaotic attractor
description: 3D nonlinear ODE with strange attractor + sensitivity to initial conditions. Substrate-relevant: chaotic dynamics in substrate retrieval + sensitivity bounds for capability paths.

name: KAM theorem
description: Quasi-periodic invariant tori survive small perturbations in Hamiltonian systems; near-integrable preserved. Substrate-relevant: stability of substrate manifold under small perturbations.

name: Fluctuation-dissipation theorem
description: Equilibrium fluctuations determine linear response to external perturbations. Substrate-relevant: substrate noise spectrum predicts response under capability-query perturbation.

name: Jarzynski equality
description: Free-energy difference from nonequilibrium work distributions: exp(-Delta F / kT) = <exp(-W/kT)>. Substrate-relevant: substrate-energy analogues for capability ordering.

name: Qubit
description: Two-level quantum system as basic unit of quantum information; Bloch sphere representation. Substrate-relevant: phasor analogue + complex amplitude binding.

name: Quantum entanglement
description: Non-separable joint state of multi-qubit systems; Bell inequality violations. Substrate-relevant: non-decomposable substrate bundles + non-classical correlations.

name: No-cloning theorem
description: Unknown quantum state cannot be perfectly copied; consequence of linearity of QM. Substrate-relevant: information-theoretic capacity limits on substrate retrieval fidelity.

name: Michaelis-Menten enzyme kinetics
description: Enzyme-substrate binding kinetics: v = Vmax [S] / (Km + [S]). Foundation for biochemical kinetics. Substrate-relevant: saturation curves analogous to substrate capacity-load curves.

name: MAPK signaling cascade
description: Mitogen-activated protein kinase cascade: Ras -> Raf -> MEK -> ERK; multi-stage amplification + ultrasensitivity. Substrate-relevant: cascade analogue for hierarchical substrate activation.

name: Hodgkin-Huxley neuron model
description: Voltage-gated ion channel model of action potential: V + n + m + h variables. Substrate-relevant: biologically-grounded spiking neuron substrate analogue.

name: Hardy-Weinberg equilibrium
description: Allele frequencies remain constant across generations under no selection/migration/mutation. Foundation for population genetics. Substrate-relevant: equilibrium analysis for substrate atom frequencies.

name: Evolutionary stable strategy (Maynard Smith)
description: Strategy resistant to invasion by mutants in game-theoretic population dynamics. Substrate-relevant: ESS analogue for substrate-update stability under adversarial atom proposals.

name: Lotka-Volterra dynamics
description: Predator-prey ODE model with oscillatory dynamics. Substrate-relevant: substrate-atom population dynamics + competitive cleanup dynamics.

name: Spike-timing-dependent plasticity
description: Synaptic weight change depends on relative spike timing: pre-before-post potentiates + reverse depresses. Substrate-relevant: temporal-policy learning rule for substrate atom weights.

name: Long-term potentiation
description: Persistent strengthening of synapses based on recent activity patterns; Hebbian + NMDA-dependent. Substrate-relevant: substrate atom weight reinforcement learning rule.

name: Levinthal paradox + protein folding
description: Astronomical conformational space vs rapid folding; resolved via funneled energy landscape. Substrate-relevant: funneled retrieval landscape for substrate cleanup.

name: Topological data analysis (persistent homology)
description: Persistent homology + Betti numbers track topological features across scales. Substrate-relevant: substrate concept-graph topology + persistent features across atom-bundling scales.

name: Percolation theory
description: Phase transition in random graph/lattice connectivity at critical density. Substrate-relevant: substrate concept-links connectivity phase transition + capability-path reachability.

name: Maxwell's demon + Landauer principle
description: Information erasure requires minimum energy kT ln 2 (Landauer). Substrate-relevant: thermodynamic cost of substrate atom updates + information-erasure cost lower bound.
